scope: Read-only official pricing/specification and pinned public-source research plus current local source/evidence inspection. Documentation only; no outreach, recruitment, new test execution, production mutation or publication.

hypothesizedCustomer.team: Small independent browser-app maintainer or team
hypothesizedCustomer.job: Recover private unfinished text after the primary app becomes unavailable, without locating a retained export file; continue editing and export
hypothesizedCustomer.initialData: One explicit snapshot of drafts, briefs or notes; current Work v1 serialized work maximum 16384 bytes
hypothesizedCustomer.requiredTradeoff: Accept a named operator responsible for the recovery origin, storage, maintenance and costs

integrationEvidence.kind: Agent-built integration executing independently authored editor/highlighter code and installing the SDK as a local tarball consumer through public entry points
integrationEvidence.limitation: Current Work v1 adapter supplies an unfunded disposable EOA and four envelope fields; upstream Textarea has only a document, no account model
integrationEvidence.textOnlyCandidate: Separate protocol work requires its own release and native acceptance evidence; no result inferred here

sources.billingApplicability: Direct Cloudflare list prices; actual Sites plan and billing unknown. No free-static-asset assumption for Worker-served assets. Other account usage consumes allowances.

sources.measurement: Billable rows are rows read/scanned or written, not SDK calls or HTTP request counts. Index and query behavior matter.

sources.limit: Small stored data does not prevent query quota exhaustion or overload; expiry or active-row cleanup is not proof of provider-level erasure.

sources.finding: Credential use is scoped by RP ID. Ordinary web use requires a matching domain or registrable suffix; the specification also describes related-origin requests, which this implementation does not implement.
relyingParty uses location.hostname; restore calls Mera getPasskeyPrfOutput using that RP ID before creating a secp256k1 signing session
sources.inferenceLimit: Illustrates RP dependence; not an integration request, adoption signal, complete recovery audit or current competitor ranking

sources.finding: exportLocker includes ciphertext, sidecars and wrapped DEKs after reference checks; importLocker republishes objects to a configured gateway and reports skipped failures
sources.inferenceLimit: Competent existing portability code; not proof of independent demand, native device acceptance or universal interchangeability

currentDemoBounds.capacityReservation: Unconsumed live admissions reserve a record slot atomically; expired admissions remain in the lifetime count
currentDemoBounds.throttle: Best-effort isolate-local admission friction; not a global rate or billing guarantee

results: Both recover when their bytes survive and A is unavailable
Reserve recovers when only the export file is missing
Retained export recovers when reserve record is missing or host is unavailable
Edited work exports correctly; original snapshot remains immutable

proposedPilot.target: Consenting maintainer of an independently maintained app matching the text-snapshot hypothesis
successGates: Real recovery job where maintained encrypted export alone is insufficient for this maintainer
Public-entrypoint integration into their actual app
Exact recovery and continued export with A unavailable using the released protocol
Maintainer chooses to retain or ship the integration after fair file comparison
stopConditions: Required data or sync exceeds scope
Integration timebox exceeded without a concrete remedy
Hosting and support responsibility not accepted
economicsUnknown: Production CPU and D1 row use
proposedPilot.conclusion: Agent work can improve implementation and evidence. Actual interest and independent continued use remain unverified and cannot be supplied by this research.
